description: This file defines the DaysAdapter class for an Android weather app, which populates a RecyclerView with daily weather forecast data, fetching data via network requests and updating UI components accordingly.

classes.name: DaysAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding daily weather data to RecyclerView items in the weather app.

classes.name: DaysAdapter.DayViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to UI components for each day item in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: DaysAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DayViewHolder by inflating the day_item_layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds weather data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items (6) in the adapter.

methods.name: getDailyWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches daily weather info from the API and updates the UI components.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI components of the ViewHolder with fetched weather data.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the progress indicator and shows the weather info layout.

methods.name: DayViewHolder
methods.description: Holds references to UI components for each weather day item.
